module_summary: State machine with 10 states controlled by single input; outputs decoded status flags.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: 4-bit state register driving all state transitions and decoded outputs.

anchors.name: disc
anchors.why: Decoded output: asserted when state equals SDISC (8).

anchors.name: flag
anchors.why: Decoded output: asserted when state equals SFLAG (9).

anchors.name: err
anchors.why: Decoded output: asserted when state equals SERR (7).

groups.name: FSM Controller
groups.description: State register with 10-state FSM driven by single input condition.

groups.name: Status Decoder
groups.description: Combinational decoders producing state-dependent status flags.
